tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. Paper for Trip, Book and You; Ink for Live, Rescue, Story and the globe.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, track backgrounds, the unfilled part of meters.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and ticket perforations. Decorative only; never the sole separator of controls.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (≥ 14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata and secondary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥ 5.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen, the 'You' provenance, Ari's scarf. Fill only; put text-on-volt on it.

tokens.name: volt-text
tokens.usage: Volt as text or icon colour on surface / surface-raised (paper uses the darkened hue for AA).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Routes, Arivo Live, the 'Live' provenance. Fill, route line and map marks.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Signal as text or icon colour on surface / surface-raised.

tokens.name: lantern
tokens.usage: Arivo Pulse, the 'Est.' provenance, budget-tight state. Fill and marks.

tokens.name: lantern-text
tokens.usage: Lantern as text or icon colour on surface / surface-raised.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Disruption, errors, removed stops, destructive confirm. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Ember as text or icon colour on surface / surface-raised.

tokens.name: route-1
tokens.usage: Day 1 route colour (map line, day dot).

tokens.name: crew-1
tokens.usage: Crew member 1 (avatar ring, constellation star, votes).

tokens.name: provenance-live
tokens.usage: LIVE tag: value came from a provider (weather, supplier price, hours) with a timestamp.

tokens.name: provenance-est
tokens.usage: EST. tag: value Arivo computed (travel time estimate, forecast, heuristic).

tokens.name: provenance-you
tokens.usage: YOU tag: value the traveller entered (budget, receipt they confirmed).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element (≥ 5:1 on all surfaces).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Destination name on trip hero. One per screen.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Onboarding prompt, section openers on ink.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Card titles, place names in lists.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Rain starts at 14:00. Plan B keeps your dinner booking.

styles.name: body-m
styles.sample: Best early to avoid heavier crowds.
styles.usage: Card body, reasons. Minimum size for paragraphs.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Booking refs, provenance tags, small numerals.

spacing.note: 4-pt grid. Screen gutter space-4 (16), space-5 on large phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; hero breathing room.

shadow.note: One level. Everything else separates by tone.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Only floating things: Guide FAB, sheets over the map, a card being dragged.

duration.note: Motion always means something: a camera move signals a new day, a route morph signals a replan, a number roll signals a budget change. Under reduced motion routes appear without drawing and Ari holds a still pose.

tokens.name: dur-route
tokens.usage: Route draw and Rescue route morph.
